repos.name: Receipt OCR
repos.desc: A full ML/AI suite for receipt OCR: data prep with WebDataset sharding (200 images → 550 GB), a multi-model evaluation harness (Donut, Qwen2-VL, TrOCR, Claude), a Donut finetune, and a FastAPI inference service.

repos.name: Jedi Council
repos.desc: A multi-agent Jedi Council deliberation system built on LangGraph — persona agents debate in public and private rounds, orchestrated through a shared graph, with a retro RPG overlay on top.

repos.name: Research Radar
repos.desc: A custom OpenClaw plugin: a conversational, multi-source ML research radar with LLM-judged relevance that learns from your in-chat 👍/👎 feedback over time.

repos.name: Document AI Pipeline
repos.desc: End-to-end Document AI pipeline for handwritten form extraction, with a human-in-the-loop feedback loop that turns corrections into better models.

repos.name: LangGraph Research Agent
repos.desc: Multi-agent equity-research system with verification gates and citation tracking, built on LangGraph + Postgres + LangSmith and served via FastAPI.

repos.name: StarCraft II Player Skill Classification
repos.desc: Classifies StarCraft II players by skill tier from gameplay telemetry — feature engineering and supervised modelling on behavioural data.

repos.name: FastAPI ML Template
repos.desc: Production-ready FastAPI + ML template: versioned routers, per-version Swagger docs, uv dependency management, and Docker out of the box.

repos.name: Git Scrub — Visual History Explorer
repos.desc: An interactive visual git-history explorer with sliders to scrub through commits — built entirely with Claude Code.

repos.name: ak-ai — Claude Code Skills & Tools
repos.desc: Open-source Claude Code skills, agents, and AI tooling — reusable building blocks for agent-driven engineering.

repos.name: AI Poetry
repos.desc: Poems written by AI models, presented in the namesake forms of the models that wrote them.
